metadata.article_title: Provisions applicable to past assessments of firms.

article.title: Provisions applicable to past assessments of firms.
article.content:
189AProvisions applicable to past assessments of firms.

Section 189A  ·  Chapter XVI  ·  C.—Changes in constitution, succession and dissolution  ·  page 706 of the Act
In relation to the assessment of any firm and its partners for the assessment year commencing on the 1st day of April, 1992, or any earlier assessment year, the provisions of this Chapter as they stood immediately before the 1st day of April, 1993, shall continue to apply.
